summary: Backend testing for Portale SLA v0.11.3-beta - Fix load .env override=False + secrets out of repo. All 12 pytest tests passed: (1) load_dotenv(override=False) verified in BOTH core/config.py and utils/config.py — pre-set os.environ value wins over .env file, and .env file value is used when os.environ is unset; (2) /api/version returns 0.11.3-beta with release_name containing 'Fix load .env'; (3) POST /api/calcola-km error handling: empty key → 500 'Google Maps API non configurata', invalid key → 400 with 'REQUEST_DENIED'; (4) Non-regression on login, /auth/me, /sedi, /rimborsi, /notifiche; (5) Rate limit 60/hour still enforced on /api/calcola-km (verified with 140 req burst). backend/.env restored to original state and backend restarted at teardown.

minor.issue: Public URL routes requests via Cloudflare + k8s ingress; the backend observes >1 client IP alternating across requests (bucket keyed on IP). To reliably trigger 60/hour on /calcola-km via the public URL we needed ~140 requests (not 62). Not a functional bug of the fix under review; observation for future rate-limit tests.

critical_code_review_comments: core/config.py and utils/config.py: BOTH modules load_dotenv independently. If someone imports utils.config first and then core.config, load_dotenv runs twice. override=False makes this safe now, but consider consolidating to a single config module to avoid maintenance drift (they already diverge — utils.config exposes Settings, core.config exposes module-level constants).

.dockerignore excludes 'tests/' and 'test_reports/' at the top level — good. But note that backend/tests/ is NOT explicitly excluded and will still be COPY-ed into the image if the Dockerfile does `COPY backend/ /app/backend/`. Consider adding 'backend/tests/' if pytest artefacts shouldn't ship to the Pi.

routes/maps.py: on httpx.RequestError it raises HTTPException 500 including the raw exception text (str(e)). Fine for debugging but could leak proxy/host info; consider logging the exception and returning a generic message.
server.py:96 Retry-After header hardcoded to 60s regardless of the actual rate-limit window; already noted in iteration_2 — not addressed yet.

core/rate_limit.py: default_limits=['200/minute'] is a safety net. With k8s ingress observing multiple client IPs per real user (Cloudflare edges), the effective per-user limit is HIGHER than the configured value. For production on a single-Pi behind a home router this is fine (single NAT'd IP), but the sandbox behavior is worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests were idempotent: /rimborsi list only (no create in this iteration). backend/.env modified transiently and restored via .env.itest_backup at module teardown; backend restarted at teardown to reload original config.
context_for_next_testing_agent: load_dotenv override=False test is done via SUBPROCESS to isolate os.environ (import-time behavior). Do NOT try to test this in-process — the config module is already imported when pytest starts and can't be re-imported cleanly. The rate-limit test is intentionally lenient (asserts >=1 429 in 140 requests) because public URL observes multiple ingress client IPs. Do NOT decrease the burst size below ~130 without verifying the ingress topology. /app/backend/.env is auto-restored at module teardown; if a test crashes mid-way, restore manually from git or set GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY back to 'AIzaSyDTFkaWGVqEqcfPcYpkE_WeLFyp55k8p3I' (the placeholder key still in the repo — .env is now git-ignored per this fix but the working-copy remains for local dev).
